name: ListDatasourceFeatureViews

parameters.help_en: Instance ID. Get this ID using the ListInstances API
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Data source ID. Get this ID using the ListDatasources API
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，可通过接口ListDatasources获取
parameters.name: datasource_id

parameters.help_en: Project ID. Get this ID using the ListProjects API
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy filter for feature view names
parameters.help_zh: 特征视图名称模糊过滤
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Feature view type.

- Batch - offline feature

- Stream - real-time feature

- Sequence - sequence feature
parameters.help_zh:
特征视图类型。
- Batch-离线特征
- Stream-实时特征
- Sequence-序列特征
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_zh: 是否返回所有数据（不分页）
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: Start time for query read/write volume. Format: yyyy-mm-dd
parameters.help_zh: 查询读写量的起始时间，格式为yyyy-mm-dd
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: End time for query read/write volume. Format: yyyy-mm-dd
parameters.help_zh: 查询读写量的截止时间，格式为yyyy-mm-dd
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: Show detailed information. If set to false, do not show UsageStatistics for each view; show only the total. Default is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否展示详细信息。如果设置为false，则不展示每个视图的UsageStatistics，只展示总量。默认为true
parameters.name: verbose

parameters.help_en: Show storage usage. Default is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否展示存储用量，默认为true
parameters.name: show_storage_usage
